title: Optional Delights
description: "Optional Delights" brings lightweight, non-intrusive gameplay extensions to Minecraft 1.20.1. The core philosophy is simple: freedom of choice. Every feature can be toggled on or off independently via config—keep what you love, ditch what you don't.
body:
# Current Features:

## Potion Coating: 
Hold a potion in your offhand and the target item in your main hand, then Sneak (Shift)+Right-click to coat your weapons, shields, or even candles with potion effects. Inflict poison on enemies, heal while blocking, or place coated candles to create ambient buff zones—combat and decoration now go hand in hand.

## Working Experience:
Gain XP from chopping trees, tilling soil, and mining blocks.

## Pumpkin Head Trading: 
Wear a Carved Pumpkin to unlock Witch trades! Witches have a fondness for strange items—Cactus, Pufferfish, Blaze Rods, Blue Ice, Spider Eyes. Hold these to catch her attention, and if the price is right, right-click to trade. Fortune or misfortune? Put on the mask and uncover the secrets of the Witch's Hut!

## Fire Extinguishing: 
Water Bottles, Honey, and Milk can douse flames on you. Splash/Lingering potions also prevent fire spread.

## Food Seasoning: 
Hold seasoning in your offhand and food in your main hand, then right-click to season your meal—unlocking a double adventure in taste and effect! Five flavors: Sweet Berries (Sweet), Glow Berries (Sour), Kelp (Salty), Blaze Powder (Spicy), Chorus Fruit (Bitter). Each cures different negative effects, like honey cures poison. Combine two seasonings for complex flavors with brand new effects—discover them yourself!

## Waxed Corals:
Right-click with honeycomb to wax corals, locking in moisture and preventing them from drying out—perfect for your land aquarium. No crafting recipe yet, cherish every piece.

## Better Goat Horn:
Ancient horns now hold new power! The Seek Horn summons two loyal Iron Golems to fight by your side; the Yearn Horn summons a swift horse to carry you across the land. Blow the horn and let the world hear your call!

## Multi-Purpose Brush: 
The brush is no longer just for archaeology! Use it to brush any block—no items will drop, it's purely for sweeping and tidying up your space. Even better, you can brush your animals to gently remove negative effects from them. Be a caring rancher!

## Clay Pottery Sherd Duplication: 
Use clay to duplicate pottery sherds! Craft them with clay, then fire them in a furnace to take shape—giving you a renewable way to collect all those decorative patterns.

### Config Tip: Search Z_mod in-game to toggle any feature on/off.


### More features are on the way. Stay tuned!
